text: I was a misandrist before I had a baby, okay? I didn't need a reason to respect men. But after having a baby, you could not pay me money to say that I think men are good at anything. Okay, guys, I'm very confused here. Maybe I'm not understanding something. But misandrist is someone who hates men. How the hell did you get pregnant then? Who got you pregnant? Another woman? Wouldn't that be all over the news? Because I spent nine months cooking this bitch, okay? Nine months throwing up my guts, clocked into work, showing up 8 a.m., throwing up my guts, building a brain. And my back hurts, and my a** hurts, and my feet hurt, and I can't sleep. Okay, so you are complaining about the whole pregnancy process, that it was so difficult. Fair enough. But you are blaming men for that? Well, if you need to find someone to blame, why don't you try looking in the mirror? I mean, who the hell in their right mind would be ready to support a woman like you? You yourself scare people away. Yes, and the fact you can't stand men doesn't help. Damn, where's at least an ounce of accountability? And men are just out there flopping their d**ks around, saying s**t like, do women deserve things? Do you deserve anything? What's the last thing you've deserved? Why do you bring men into that? Again, are there men who say stupid things about women? Sure, there are. But most support, respect, and cherish women. We have mothers, sisters, colleagues, and so on. What is your problem? And how it has to do with your issues? Take some accountability for your life and for your decisions. Okay, she actually has a husband. Again, how can a person who dislikes men so much have a husband? It doesn't make any sense. And damn, that should be one miserable guy. Imagine he needs to deal with this lady on a daily basis. On the other hand, should we be sorry for him? I guess it is his choice. So he needs to have accountability too. Again, I don't know who says that women do not deserve maternity leave. If your husband is saying this, again, why are you with your husband? But you know what is the saddest part here? Is that there's a baby in this whole story. That a baby is born and needs to be brought up in a family like that. The whole life, the baby will probably have one question. Why? Why was I born in a family like that? What did I do? I don't have much sympathy towards this woman or her husband. They are adults and these are their decisions. So they deserve what they have. But I am sad for that poor little baby. At least he or she didn't deserve that.
